\title{Ranking Flaky Test Failures}
\author{\IEEEauthorblockN{Anonymous Author(s)}}
\maketitle
\begin{abstract}
Flaky tests pass and fail on the same code. The ranking places the flaky failure first.
\end{abstract}
\section{Introduction}
Flaky tests pass and fail on the same code. The pipeline of the tool appears in Fig.~\lost\ and
the projects of the study in Table~\lost\ of the next section. The build log of each project
prints ``Error! File not found.'' when a test resource is missing, which the tool reads as a
sign of a flaky failure.
\section{Method}
The tool ranks the failures of a build by their history, as \textbf{Error! Bookmark not defined.}
describes for the order of the tests.
